bead.title: Specify async batching and SQLite high-water contract
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The docs do not define how async SQLite apply is ordered, how batches are sealed and replayed, or how SQLite logical high-water differs from WAL/fsync state.

ROOT CAUSE: `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:273` requires SQLite-first apply for the existing hybrid path; `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:287` defines SQLite export and high-water for recovery; `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md:403` says local SQLite high-water is not a segment-expiry authority, but none of these lines define async ordered batching or distinguish logical high-water from WAL durability.

PROPOSED FIX: Update the governing artifacts `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md`, `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md`, `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md`, and `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md` to specify the `hybrid-async` ordered batching contract. Define batch sequence ordering, exactly-once async apply, how readers observe memory versus SQLite projection state, `sqlite_high_water` as a logical applied-command marker, and WAL/fsync state as a local durability implementation detail that never authorizes object-log trimming.

NON-SCOPE: Code changes; implementation of batching workers; changes outside the four governing artifact references; altering existing dependency ID `pqueue-b207e65d`; weakening the required verification commands.

DEPENDENCY: parent `pqueue-b207e65d`.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestHybridAsyncOrderedBatchingSpec: `rg -n 'ordered batching|sqlite_high_water|WAL|logical high-water|hybrid-async' docs/helix docs/perf` succeeds and shows ordered async batch apply, logical high-water, and WAL distinction in the governing artifacts.
2. TestHybridAsyncBatchingNoCodeScope: `git diff --name-only` after the bead contains only `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md`, `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md`, `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-003-verification-acceptance-criteria.md`, and `docs/perf/tp002-objectlog-hybrid-evidence.md`.
3. TestHybridAsyncBatchingCargoGate: `cargo test -p pqueue-release ledger_path_honors_env_override_and_default` passes.
4. TestHybridAsyncBatchingFmtGate: `cargo fmt --check` passes.
5. TestHybridAsyncBatchingGoGate: `go test ./...` passes or records a no-Go-module skip with the exact command output.
6. TestHybridAsyncBatchingLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
